headline: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon globally available at an introductory price
body: Google says Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available for developers and enterprises via the API. The introductory price is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. After the introductory period expires on November 30, 2026, $4 per 1M input tokens and $20 per 1M output tokens will apply.
note: For banks and payment firms, the price is the figure to set against current model bills, and the introductory price ends on November 30, 2026.
